name: pi-subagents
notes:
Forked from nicobailon/pi-subagents; local compatibility fixes preserve @xzzpig/pi-permission-system priority in resolvePermissionSystemExtension() (now in src/runs/shared/child-tool-plan.ts). Fleet native transcript (openspec fleet-native-transcript): src/tui/fleet-native-transcript.ts (JSONL→shared-library entries adapter + Pi-native renderer via guarded dynamic import of @xzzpig/pi-components/transcript), wiring in src/tui/fleet.ts (renderer mode cache branch, v/V toggleRenderer keybinding, legacy fallback), @xzzpig/pi-components bundled via bundledDependencies (private, never published), and shared readTranscriptRecords export in src/tui/fleet-transcript.ts. Fork-only additions: context injection (src/extension/context-injection.ts, injectToContext frontmatter field, subagents.injectAgents setting, doctor reporting) and the shared agent-eject API (src/api/agent-management.ts, ejectAgentDefinition) used by pi-goal-x. The old Pi SDK streamFn option-naming divergence was dropped: upstream ships agentStreamOptions() dual-name handling. v0.68.0 sync adopted upstream's removal of fallbackModels / same-launch model switching / persistent model exclusions (do not re-port the fork's multi-model loop onto execution.ts or subagent-runner.ts), upstream's herdr pane-native placement plus the src/inspectors/herdr collapse, and upstream's createCapturedChildHooks / buildRunnerChildLaunch / resolveLaunchBinding architecture; the fork's sandbox-profile and permission-profile threading (RunnerSubagentStep.sandbox/permissionProfile, LaunchBindingSource fields, resolveSandboxExtension, preflight untrusted_project validation) must be re-applied on each future sync. Known accepted lint debt after the v0.68.0 sync: pi-lens reports ~72 blocking findings across ~40 files dominated by no-unknown-returns, require-safety-comment-for-as-unknown-as, unchecked-throwing-call, and error-swallowing on upstream-original code, plus known false positives (TS1470 import.meta on ESM sources, Vite-style query-string imports in async-spawn-package-dir.test.ts); by decision on 2026-09-17 the fork keeps upstream code byte-identical instead of adding per-site inline suppressions, so the findings are recorded as accepted debt and re-checked on the next sync rather than fixed in-tree. 2026-09-19 conflict-surface pass: eject implementation moved from src/agents/agent-management.ts to fork-only src/agents/agent-eject.ts (agent-management.ts now exports sanitizeName/availableAgentNames/nameExistsInScope for it, handleEject delegates unchanged, src/api/agent-management.ts re-exports from agent-eject.ts). Fork-appended test blocks moved out of the upstream test files into fork-only test/unit/fork-*.test.ts (agent-frontmatter, child-tool-plan-profiles, fleet, preflight, doctor); agent-frontmatter/child-tool-plan-permission-system/fleet/preflight/doctor test files are byte-identical to upstream again. The profile-name validation try/catch copies were replaced by validateSandboxProfileNameOptional/validatePermissionProfileNameOptional in src/shared/{sandbox,permission}-profile.ts, and the six project-trust error copies merged into projectScopedProfileTrustError in src/runs/shared/sandbox-profile-guard.ts (all error messages byte-identical). Fork doc chapters moved to docs/fork-extensions.md (agents.md keeps only its 8 necessary inline lines, extension-api.md keeps the @xzzpig renames, README anchor updated). Pi 0.85.1 host-compat cluster is fork-necessary and recorded for future syncs: tool-result dedup in src/runs/foreground/execution.ts (message_end role=toolResult vs tool_result_end dual channel), modelRegistry.refresh shape compat, devDeps bump to 0.85.1. .oxlintrc.json overrides intentionally stay broad: narrowing them re-enables ~11k anti-slop errors across ~436 upstream files that upstream never satisfied; accepted debt. Known pre-existing test failures (verified present at the upstream-anchored baseline): 'copies a package agent that shadows a builtin by runtime precedence', 'also disables a package agent via a settings override', 'prunes repo internals and nested project roots from broad package discovery', 'preserves canonical contact_supervisor progress and structured-interview semantics'. 2026-09-19 P2 pass: resolveSandboxExtension and the sandbox/permission-profile decision inside resolvePiLaunchToolPlan moved to fork-only src/runs/shared/profile-extensions.ts (resolveProfileExtensions; error strings byte-identical), and the profile launch-env construction in buildInProcessChildLaunch moved to fork-only src/runs/shared/profile-launch-env.ts (buildProfileLaunchEnv); child-tool-plan.ts and child-launch.ts keep only seams (imports, input fields, one call each). SANDBOX_PROFILE_GUARD_EXTENSION_PATH stays in child-tool-plan.ts to avoid a TDZ-prone cycle.
v0.71.0 sync (2026-09-25, fork 0.17.0, SDK baseline raised to pi 0.87.0 devDeps per user directive): adopted upstream's runner refactor (subagent-runner-bootstrap entry, Git-routing env strip via omitGitRoutingEnv, runner exit-code reporting, workflow terminal proof, symlinked prompt workflows, tool-activation smoke). Tool-budget blocked detection (isToolBudgetBlockedMessage + authoritative tool name) re-applied INSIDE fork-only handleToolResult in execution.ts — the message_end role=toolResult dedup wrapper was rebuilt around upstream's new usage-completeness body (inputUsageComplete/projectCompleteUsage; upstream moved progress.inputTokens/outputTokens out of the message handler). Fork profile threading re-applied: sandbox/permissionProfile/hostAvailableBuiltins in child-tool-plan/child-launch/preflight/parallel-utils/async-execution/async-resume (getHostBuiltinToolNames restored to child-tool-plan.ts — fork-only, upstream dropped it). Upstream REMOVED completionGuard entirely — adopted (removed from AgentConfig pick, registry fields, parallel-utils, async-execution, async-resume validation). allowedAgents (upstream new) merged alongside fork fields in descriptor known-fields and agents.ts unsupported list. MCP rules: upstream applyRuntimeAgentSettings/mergeRuntimeAgents adopted in extension/index.ts (upstream inlined what fork's runtime-discovery.ts wraps — fork wrapper kept for external callers). package-lock.json taken as upstream bytes. Shim updates (upstream-owned fixture): createReadOnlyTools stub now carries JSON-serializable parameters (pi-agent-core 0.87 serializes declarations on Agent construction) and keyText stub returns '' (unconfigured) to match upstream widget tests. NOTE: pnpm file: dep copy at packages/pi-subagents/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent is NOT auto-refreshed by pnpm install on shim edits — re-copy manually after touching the fixture. Known failing tests (upstream-anchored, child-process env): tool-activation 4 subtests + advertised-agent-refresh (host version gate measures shim 0.0.0 < 0.86.1 floor → eager fallback; test expects activated mode) and advertised-agent-refresh getEntries (upstream mock lacks getEntries that upstream's own resetSessionState calls). Fix would need the workspace catalog pi-coding-agent at >=0.87 (repo-wide decision, pending). Unreleased changelog section added per upstream changelog-format test.
v0.72.0 sync (2026-09-27, fork 0.18.0, ref moved to tag v0.72.0): adopted upstream lazy executor/Fleet loading, global npm root discovery (collectPackageSubagentPaths globalNpmRoot option, resolveGlobalNpmRoot import in extension/index.ts), external inspector registration (./inspectors export + getInspectorPlugins getter; both openSubagentFleet call sites now lazy dynamic imports passing inspectorPlugins: () => getInspectorPlugins(pi) with fork's events: pi.events retained; OpenFleetFromStatusOptions.inspectorPlugins switched to getter form), fast-mode provider-prefix matching (FAST_MODE_PROVIDER_PREFIX; fork PI_BUILTIN_TOOL_NAMES retained for hostAvailableBuiltins), watchdog helper model calls via ctx.modelRegistry.streamSimple (#2497), ManagementContext.discoverAgentsAll + discoverCatalog indirection (fork cwd-based eject exports renamed availableAgentNamesForCwd/nameExistsInScopeForCwd for agent-eject.ts; ManagementContext keeps fork isProjectTrusted), async before_agent_start + waitForAdvertisement with fork context-injection handler preserved. package.json: typebox deps→optional peer + devDep 1.3.27 (adopted), ./inspectors export added, fork publishConfig/bundledDependencies/shim devDep kept. SDK pins stay at upstream 0.87.0 per user decision 2026-09-27 — fork 'as StreamFn' casts applied at prompt-audit.ts:72, review.ts:280, permission-arbiter.ts (recurring on syncs touching those sites; needed because root-hoisted pi-ai 0.87.1 type identity clashes with the package's local 0.87.0). Do NOT bump pins to 0.87.1 without fixture work: pi-agent-core 0.87.x harness/context.js imports chord BACKGROUND_CONTEXT while the shim fixture's vendored chord stub is `export {}`, so a 0.87.1-paired runner child crashes at startup. OPERATIONAL: every `pnpm install` re-copies test/fixtures/pi-coding-agent-shim (with the empty chord stub) over packages/pi-subagents/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent — after each install, `rm -rf` that copy's node_modules/@earendil-works/chord so resolveHostPeerAliases walks up to the real hoisted chord; otherwise nested external-job runner-child tests fail with "does not provide an export named 'BACKGROUND_CONTEXT'". Upstream inline eject body dropped in favor of fork delegation (upstream v0.72 eject delta was ctx plumbing only); CHANGELOG keeps fork-only sections (upstream [0.72.0] section not adopted).
 Shim fixture gained a createEventBus runtime export (types already declared it) for the v0.72 inspector-registration and extension-maintenance-lifecycle tests; the manifest consumer tsconfig pins @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent to the shim dist types (hoistedDependencyPath) so the consumer graph matches the package devDeps instead of the workspace-hoisted 0.87.1 copy. Pre-existing unrecorded fork try/catch in agent-management.jsonDetails restored to upstream bytes (upstream v0.71 and v0.72 both plain; no fork test depended on the wrapped message).
